trainer: llama-finetune (full fine-tune, AdamW, ctx 256, 1 epoch per run, -lr as tagged, -s 1)

replay_data: FLORES English passages behind Belebele (Wikinews/Wikivoyage/Wikibooks), not the XQuAD eval text
